mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_chapter (project_id, chapter_plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, word_count, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{chapterPlanId}, #{chapterNumber}, #{title}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), chapter_plan_id = VALUES(chapter_plan_id), title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), word_count = VALUES(word_count), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM story_chapter WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND chapter_number = #{chapterNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM story_chapter WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY chapter_number ASC
SELECT FROM story_chapter WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND (content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY chapter_number ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_chapter WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
